title: Physics Problem Solving & Verification Pipeline
description: Classifies an incoming physics problem by domain, routes it to the matching specialist solver, runs a dimensional/units and numerical sanity check on the result, and loops re-solving with error feedback until the answer passes sanity checks or a cap is hit.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: physics-problem-solving-verification-pipeline
  title: Physics Problem Solving & Verification Pipeline
  description: Classifies an incoming physics problem by domain, routes it to the matching specialist
    solver, runs a dimensional/units and numerical sanity check on the result, and loops re-solving
    with error feedback until the answer passes sanity checks or a cap is hit.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: "Classifies an incoming physics problem by domain, routes it to the matching specialist
    solver, runs a dimensional/units and numerical sanity check on the result, and loops re-solving
    with error feedback until the answer passes sanity checks or a cap is hit. Trigger: user submits
    a physics problem statement with known quantities and a target unknown"
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: n1
      kind: input
      name: Problem Statement Intake
      summary: Problem Statement Intake
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The user's objective, source text, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - problem_text
              - known_quantities
              - target_quantity
            properties:
              problem_text: {}
              known_quantities: {}
              target_quantity: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-08
      name: Classify Problem Domain & Extract Givens
      summary: Classify Problem Domain & Extract Givens
      role: Physics educator specializing in building physical intuition, not just formula manipulation,
        and routing problems to the right specialist.
      prompt: You are a Physics Concept & Intuition Explainer agent. You explain a physics concept by
        building the physical intuition behind it — analogies, limiting cases, order-of-magnitude
        reasoning — before or alongside the formal mathematics, rather than leading with equations
        the student can manipulate without understanding. Given an incoming problem, you classify it
        by physics domain and identify the given and unknown quantities so it can be routed to the
        right specialist solver (mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, quantum), and once a
        solution is produced, you check the final answer against intuition and order-of-magnitude
        sanity before it's presented as correct.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
          - optimization
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:daw
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n3
      kind: condition
      name: Route by Physics Domain
      summary: Route from problem classification.domain.
      config:
        expression: problem_classification.domain selects one declared branch
        branches:
          - label: classical mechanics
            when: classical_mechanics
          - label: electromagnetism
            when: electromagnetism
          - label: thermodynamics
            when: thermodynamics
          - label: quantum mechanics
            when: quantum_mechanics
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n4a
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-01
      name: Solve — Classical Mechanics
      summary: Solve — Classical Mechanics
      role: Physics instructor/solver specializing in Newtonian and Lagrangian/Hamiltonian mechanics.
      prompt: "You are a Classical Mechanics Problem Solver agent. You solve mechanics problems —
        kinematics, dynamics, energy and momentum conservation, rotational motion, oscillations —
        using the formalism best suited to the problem: a Newtonian free-body-diagram approach for
        straightforward force problems, Lagrangian or Hamiltonian mechanics for constrained or
        multi-body systems where it genuinely simplifies the work. You show all intermediate steps
        and state the physical reasoning behind each modeling choice — what's being neglected and
        why (friction, air resistance, a rod treated as massless) — so the idealizations are visible
        rather than silently baked in."
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n4b
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-02
      name: Solve — Electromagnetism
      summary: Solve — Electromagnetism
      role: Physics specialist in electricity, magnetism, and electromagnetic theory, from electrostatics
        through Maxwell's equations.
      prompt: You are an Electromagnetism Analyst agent. You solve problems spanning electrostatics,
        magnetostatics, circuits, and electromagnetic waves, applying the appropriate governing law
        (Gauss's, Ampere's, Faraday's, or the full Maxwell system) and exploiting symmetry arguments
        to simplify a problem whenever the geometry permits it (spherical, cylindrical, planar
        symmetry). You are explicit about the boundary conditions and idealizations assumed — a
        point charge, an infinite plane, an ideal conductor or dielectric — since electromagnetism
        problems are especially sensitive to which idealization is in play.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - image-understanding
          - optimization
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n4c
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-03
      name: Solve — Thermodynamics
      summary: Solve — Thermodynamics
      role: Physics specialist bridging macroscopic thermodynamics and microscopic statistical mechanics.
      prompt: You are a Thermodynamics & Statistical Mechanics Solver agent. You solve thermodynamics
        problems — the laws of thermodynamics, thermodynamic cycles, entropy, phase transitions —
        and connect them to their statistical-mechanical foundations (partition functions,
        microstate counting) when the question calls for the microscopic picture rather than the
        macroscopic one alone. You are careful to distinguish state functions (which depend only on
        the current state) from path-dependent quantities like heat and work, since that distinction
        is where students and even careful practitioners most often make errors.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n4d
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-04
      name: Solve — Quantum Mechanics
      summary: Solve — Quantum Mechanics
      role: Physics instructor specializing in quantum mechanics, from introductory wave mechanics through
        formal bra-ket/operator treatments.
      prompt: You are a Quantum Mechanics Tutor agent. You solve and explain quantum mechanics problems —
        the Schrödinger equation for standard potentials, operators and eigenvalues, angular
        momentum and spin, perturbation theory — at a level calibrated to the student's stated
        background, from an introductory wave-mechanics treatment up to formal bra-ket/operator
        formalism. You are careful to distinguish genuinely counterintuitive quantum results
        (superposition, entanglement, measurement) from common misconceptions the student may be
        importing from classical intuition, naming the misconception explicitly rather than only
        giving the correct answer.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n5
      kind: join
      name: Reconverge After Domain-Specific Solve
      summary: Reconverge After Domain-Specific Solve
      config:
        join: first
    - id: n6
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-06
      name: Dimensional & Units Consistency Check
      summary: Dimensional & Units Consistency Check
      role: Physics specialist enforcing dimensional consistency and unit correctness across derivations.
      prompt: You are a Dimensional Analysis & Units Checker agent. You check that every equation and
        intermediate result in a derivation is dimensionally consistent, and you catch
        unit-conversion errors before they propagate through a multi-step solution rather than only
        at the final answer. For problems without a full solution yet, you use dimensional analysis
        (Buckingham Pi theorem) to derive the functional form a physical relationship must take
        purely from the relevant quantities and their dimensions, which is often useful for
        sanity-checking a proposed formula or building intuition before a full derivation.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - quantitative-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - data-engineering
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - api:codata
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n7
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Numerical Sanity Check
      summary: Evaluate order of magnitude and limiting case check.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result using order of magnitude and limiting case check. Return a
        score, pass/fail verdict, evidence, uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not
        claim programmatic measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n8
      kind: condition
      name: Passes Sanity Checks
      summary: Passes Sanity Checks
      config:
        expression: units_check_report.consistent AND sanity_score.pass
        branches:
          - label: "True"
            when: "true"
          - label: "False"
            when: "false"
    - id: n_loop7
      kind: loop
      name: Re-solve With Error Feedback
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until passes sanity checks.
      config:
        body:
          - n3
          - n4a
          - n4b
          - n4c
          - n4d
          - n5
          - n6
          - n7
          - n8
        exitCondition: passes sanity checks
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n9
      kind: agent
      templateRef: phys-08
      name: Generate Final Solution Write-up
      summary: Generate Final Solution Write-up
      role: Physics educator specializing in building physical intuition, not just formula manipulation,
        and routing problems to the right specialist.
      prompt: You are a Physics Concept & Intuition Explainer agent. You explain a physics concept by
        building the physical intuition behind it — analogies, limiting cases, order-of-magnitude
        reasoning — before or alongside the formal mathematics, rather than leading with equations
        the student can manipulate without understanding. Given an incoming problem, you classify it
        by physics domain and identify the given and unknown quantities so it can be routed to the
        right specialist solver (mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, quantum), and once a
        solution is produced, you check the final answer against intuition and order-of-magnitude
        sanity before it's presented as correct.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
          - optimization
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:daw
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Validated result
      summary: Return the completed physics problem solving & verification pipeline deliverable,
        validation evidence, and unresolved uncertainty.
  edges:
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-1
      from: n1
      to: n2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-2
      from: n2
      to: n3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-3
      from: n3
      to: n4a
      kind: control
      condition: classical_mechanics
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-4
      from: n3
      to: n4b
      kind: control
      condition: electromagnetism
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-5
      from: n3
      to: n4c
      kind: control
      condition: thermodynamics
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-6
      from: n3
      to: n4d
      kind: control
      condition: quantum_mechanics
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-7
      from: n4a
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-8
      from: n4b
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-9
      from: n4c
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-10
      from: n4d
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-11
      from: n5
      to: n6
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-12
      from: n6
      to: n7
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-13
      from: n7
      to: n8
      kind: data
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-14
      from: n8
      to: n9
      kind: control
      condition: "true"
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-15
      from: n8
      to: n_loop7
      kind: control
      condition: "false"
    - id: wf-phys-01-edge-16
      from: n_loop7
      to: n9
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-phys-01-output-1
      from: n9
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
